title: Ozzy Osborne signing autographs in mall world
content: Last night I found myself in the usual mall I go to in my dreams. It’s empty and deserted, but then suddenly I found myself in this line up going into a well-lit room, but it was draped in black sheets and a couple of blank projector screens and ozzy osborne was at a table with about three crew members, and the place was a ZOO. After a few moments of nonsensical dream randomness, I made it over to him and asked for an autograph and he leaned over and stuck his tongue down my throat and I gushed. Then photographer made me take a photo with him and I was feeling star stuck and special when I heard someone angrily shout at us from the crowd « HEY! COME ON! THIS IS MY DREAM TOO!!» I don’t expect anyone was at that mall last night, but thought it was funny and worth posting anyways 😂
